summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, reporting transactions in its own securities by management and related persons under CVM Resolution #44/2021 and CVM Instruction #358/2002. The filing discloses opening and closing balances of common and preferred shares held by management, group members, and fiscal council, with no transactions executed during the period. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of insider trading activity, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or other transformative event terms disclosed; it is merely a periodic compliance filing.
